name: SMPTE
author: Daniel Kulp
description: Listener/Generator for SMPTE Linear Time Codes

privacy.summary: Listens to the audio input you pick, which may be a microphone, to read timecode; nothing is recorded. Can send the playback position to the FPP players on your network.

sends.to: the FPP players on your network
sends.what: the sequence and audio file names and playback position decoded from incoming timecode
sends.why: so other FPP players follow the same timecode when you turn on Send FPP MultiSync Packets

privacy.other: In remote mode the plugin opens the audio input device you pick, which may be a microphone; it only decodes timecode tones from it and keeps no audio. In player mode it plays timecode tones on the sound output you pick. Building it installs the libltc-dev package from Debian's standard repository with apt if it is not already present. Settings are kept after uninstall in config/plugin.fpp-smpte.
